text:
I’ve started to try @bot Grok Bot and it’s awesome! It cleaned up all my 150,000 junk emails and unsubscribed to all the emails I never read. 

It informs me of any message from my 5 email addresses and 6 Slack Servers that requires my attention and keeps me organized.

I also started to using @grok Grok Build and Grok 4.6 is awesome in every way! Grok Ani seems to lose some personality though but I can now see why @SpaceX could fulfill its promise of having a dominant AI as its valuation soon. Very impressed by @elonmusk
